evidence_scope: Native text-token MTP execution on the named M5 hardware and pinned packs; not checkpoint, speed, safety, image, or default-promotion certification.

vision.reason: BF16 sidecar integrity verified; no image-generation or image-quality test.

mtp_acceleration.reason: Native drafting and verification executed with no recorded direct fallback. No paired performance workloads or MTP-S safety qualification were run.

notes: Runtime validation was requested on MacBook Pro M5 Max 128 GiB. No formal Tier 1 or Tier 2 certification was performed.
Both bench and server emitted 32 tokens and reported positive native MTP draft and verify counters with zero direct-fallback steps.
The sidecar declares one MTP layer; the current throughput policy reports iterative draft depth 3. No speed multiplier is authorized.
The raw local-directory runs report generic model IDs qwen3 and qwen3.6-mtp; pack identity is bound by the pinned revision and artifact manifest, not those response labels.
The initial Cyber launch rejected a missing vision sidecar. It was downloaded and verified before the retained successful run.

plan.notes: Manifest target_class remains 8bit from the allocator; the shipped trunk quantization is MXFP4/group32. These fields are not interchangeable.
plan.pack_format: MXFP4/group32 with protected affine and BF16 tensors

public_index.display_name: Cyber Tiel Coder 35B-A3B MLX AXQ MXFP4 MTP

quality.reason: A single synthetic token-ID prompt with a 32-token output cap exercises the runtime route; it is not a quality-retention suite.

runtime_default.notes: Publisher enabled_by_default metadata is not AX Engine default promotion.

thresholds.notes: No BF16 or uniform baseline comparison was run; checkpoint thresholds are not satisfied by runtime smoke evidence.
